name: Biffa Award Nature Recovery (Rebuilding Biodiversity) grants
summary: Grants of £10,000 to £75,000 for constituted charities and not-for-profits to reintroduce or improve habitats and species near Biffa operations and landfill sites. Projects need public access or volunteer involvement and a biodiversity management plan.

applicant_types.quote: Your organisation must be a fully constituted, charitable or not-for-profit with no share capital.

access.quote: If planning permission is required, it must have been granted before you submit an Expression of Interest

amount.quote: Application value must be between £10,000 and £75,000

co_finance_required.quote: A Third Party Contributor should be identified to fund 10% of the application value
